result.title: Angular Conditional Distillation: Overcoming Classifier Geometry Mismatch
result.summary: Classifier outputs provide a fundamental and univer- sally available knowledge interface for knowledge distil- lation (KD). However, standard logit objectives entangle transferable semantic relations with architecture-dependent parameterization artifacts, causing a classifier geometry mismatch that makes direct knowledge transfer unreliable. To address this, we propose Angular Conditional Distilla- tion (ACD). First, the Angular Coordinate Interface (ACI) reconstructs the student classifier using angular coordi- nates, suppressing magnitude and bias effects to provide a geometry-compatible space. Then, Scale-Invariant Condi- tional Distillation (SICD) standardizes outputs and exclu- sively transfers conditional non-target relations, filtering out untransferable absolute confidence. Together, ACI de- fines where to transfer, while SICD defines what to transfer. Extensive experiments show that ACD achieves state-of-the- art performance over existing KD methods. Moreover, as a universal drop-in replacement, it consistently improves existing distillation pipelines while requiring no feature adapters or additional inference-time cost. Code is avail- able at https://github.com/laniusnan/ACD.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对知识蒸馏中教师与学生分类器的几何不匹配问题，提出 Angular Conditional Distillation：先用角度坐标接口构造几何兼容的表征空间，再用尺度不变的条件蒸馏只迁移非目标类之间的相对关系，滤除不可迁移的绝对置信度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「几何兼容空间 + 尺度不变条件关系」的表示几何思路，可能为 latent 推理状态间的相似度比较与跨模型/跨轨迹蒸馏监督提供借鉴，尤其可核查其中尺度与偏置归一化是否适用于非分类器输出。
